svg.title: It is uniform on permitted normalized supports and chart parameters. The subtraction length can be fixed or vary under the same halo, support and clearance conditions; it need not equal R. If f vanishes near the total diagonal N⊥ g , its normal jets annihilate Cg in CE16. Hence full and punctured scores agree on these tests even if proper-subcluster collision sets are met. Every positive normal annulus qualifies, also after scaling, with no uniform lower bound on its hole. CE18 therefore bounds full, output and remainder punctured pairings with the same constants.
